Northwind Tools Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

SPRINGFIELD, Ill., November 12, 2026 — Northwind Tools Inc (NYSE: NWT) today reported net sales of $412.6 million for the quarter ended September 26, 2026, up 9% from a year earlier.
